instruction: Create one Part Design body. First create an additive box blank sized 46 mm along global X, 30 mm along global Y, and 18 mm along global Z, with its lower-back-left corner at the origin so the box spans X = 0 to 46, Y = 0 to 30, and Z = 0 to 18. Then create a subtractive wedge to cut a sloped pocket into the right side of the box. Use wedge primitive parameters X min/max = 0/10 mm, Y min/max = 0/10 mm, Z min/max = 0/10 mm, X2 min/max = 2/8 mm, and Z2 min/max = 2/8 mm. Align the wedge local axes to the global axes and place its local origin at (36, 10, 4), so the wedge spans global X = 36 to 46, Y = 10 to 20, and Z = 4 to 14 and opens through the right face at X = 46. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
